System declares compatibility minimum: 14.361; incompatible with FVTT 14.360.0 (one build below the required minimum). The earlier "failed"/rate-limit diagnoses were misdiagnoses of this same genuine incompatibility - monitor-releases.ts's compatibility check only compared major-version integers and missed the build-level minimum bump, and separately never re-checked newer 14.x builds once 14.360.0 went stable for this generation. Both fixed.

Confirmed incompatible: dnd5e 5.2.x was never intended to support FoundryVTT V14 (maintainer confirmation: https://github.com/foundryvtt/dnd5e/issues/6704 - "it isn't expected that 5.2.x be compatible with V14. The 5.3.x branch is already."). Actor creation crashes with [Actor5e] validation errors (SchemaField#_validateRecursive on currency/abilities/skills/tools/traits) on every V14 build tested (14.360.0, 14.365, 14.366, 14.367). Not a foundry-playwright regression.

The 5.3.x branch is already."); 5.1.x being older cannot be compatible either. This row was previously recorded "failed" due to an unrelated foundry-playwright bug (an unbounded wait in returnToSetup causing a beforeAll hook timeout, fixed in #162) that masked the real result - confirmed via direct manual reproduction: actor creation crashes with "Class EnchantmentData must define a changes field in its schema", the same failure class already documented for 5.2.x. Not a foundry-playwright regression.

dnd5e v5.2.5 never supports Foundry V14 - its own manifest sets no compatibility maximum (minimum: 13.347, verified: 13 only), and dnd5e 5.3.0's release notes state V14 support was added in that release. Reproduced locally against FVTT 14.368: Actor5e schema validation crashes on actor creation (SchemaField#_validateRecursive fails identically across every MappingField-based system field - currency/abilities/skills/tools/spells/traits). Same root incompatibility already recorded against FVTT 14.360.0 below - not a flake, will never pass on any V14 build.
